summary: Gold X2 Mining filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent: foreign private issuer current report) on September 21, 2026, updating its royalty spin-out and other corporate matters. The company intends to create a 1.00% net smelter royalty on future Moss Gold Project production, initially held by a wholly-owned SpinCo, then distributed pro rata to shareholders of record on a date to be set; an arrangement agreement is still being prepared. It also disclosed a binding LOI to acquire Bold Ventures mineral claims for C$500,000 cash, 150,000 shares and a 2.00% REE NSR. Watch TSXV and regulatory approvals, definitive agreements, and Record Date timing.
